verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird's VC practice pages explicitly position the firm as an international adviser to investors across UK/Europe/Asia/US, covering the 'complete spectrum' of VC work from seed to exit, and its global office network spans multiple jurisdictions relevant to cross-border deals; its SCC Generator tool also directly addresses EU-mandated cross-border data transfer documentation. Missing for 10: explicit mention of redomiciliation/flip transactions, concrete client case studies of multi-jurisdiction financings, and independent corroboration beyond firm's own site.
